vz — reproducible, parallel Developer Environments

Usage: vz [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  up      Create/reconcile the selected Environment (Linux and native macOS on Apple silicon; DEV)
  stop    Stop the selected Developer Environment, preserving identities and state
  delete  Delete the selected Environment and its owned resources (Linux and native macOS on Apple silicon; DEV)
  exec    Execute in one selected Ready Machine (Linux and native macOS on Apple silicon; DEV)
  status  Show the project's persisted Developer Environment topology
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -v, --verbose...  Increase log verbosity (-v for debug, -vv for trace)
  -q, --quiet       Suppress non-error output
      --json        Output as JSON (for scripting)
  -h, --help        Print help
  -V, --version     Print version

Examples:
  vz                  Show this help without touching runtime state
  vz status --json    Inspect the selected Environment topology
  vz exec -- uname -s  Execute in the selected Ready Machine

Implementation status: DEV. All five lifecycle verbs are present; complete 0.4 topology support is not yet shipped.
